summary: The snapshot mostly preserves the headline boundary that the strict H1-H6 main question remains [UNKNOWN], but it is not safe to keep as a [SYN] aggregate in its current form. It reintroduces a retracted Sub-Q4 attribution claim, misstates the R0.2 upgrade invariant in several places, and contains source-faithfulness errors in both the lower-bound/gap constants and the H1-H6 scope caveats. Those defects are fixable, but as written the document repeats the kind of retraction-pattern slippage it was supposed to avoid.

issues.description: The `S4` row reintroduces `Gap 归因 γ (两端松) 最可能` as a live [CONJ] proposition. That directly conflicts with the cited source posture: FINDINGS v2 §4.2 explicitly says the interim withdraws any `γ` pre-location, RETRACTION §3.2 says the `γ(两端都松)的预判` was retracted, and `gap_shape_g4_1.md` says the current work characterizes shape only, not attribution. The same section also says attribution is `[UNKNOWN]` at line 113, so the document is internally inconsistent as well as source-inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Delete `S4` or replace it with a non-attribution status such as `[UNKNOWN]` / `blocked pending Sub-Q3 upper-bound upgrade`, and keep all A/B/C attribution language out of the lookup tables until Sub-Q3 is upgraded as the source documents require.

issues.description: The upgrade-path wording violates the project invariant. This line says a [SYN] aggregation can become `[COROLLARY]` with `user sign-off`, and related lines (97, 117, 145-157) imply that user formalization or `user C1 + C2` is enough to upgrade. CLAUDE.md R0.2 and `.claude/rules/research-rigor.md` R2.2 require `C1 ∧ C2 ∧ C3` for every `[COROLLARY]`/`[THM]` upgrade; user work may satisfy `C1(b)`, but it never removes the need for `C3`.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite every upgrade sentence/table entry to state the full invariant explicitly: upgrade requires `C1 AND C2 AND C3`; user paper-proof work can satisfy `C1(b)` but does not bypass `C3`.

issues.description: The lower-bound/gap constants are not faithful to the cited sources. The bullet says the gap is `1.1·√η` from `1.44` versus a TF lower bound `0.3`, while also saying the prefactor gap is `~1000×`; those numbers are incompatible (`1.44/0.3 ≈ 4.8`, not 1000). FINDINGS v2 distinguishes `c_strict ≈ 0.2` for strict `T_umr` TF/PM achievability and `c_ext ≈ 0.3` only for extended `T_umr+` MP-QKD, while `gap_shape_g4_1.md` uses PM-QKD numerical lower bounds around `10^-3·√η`. The same misquote is repeated in `P3` at line 186 (`0.3·√η via TF-QKD`).
issues.suggestion: Correct the constants and topology labels to match FINDINGS v2 and `gap_shape_g4_1.md`, or avoid prefactor arithmetic entirely and keep the statement at the exponent/order-of-growth level.

issues.description: The scope note for `T1` says the point-to-point PLOB corollary differs from the main setting only by excluding an untrusted relay (`原始 H1-H6 不含 untrusted relay`). That is not faithful to FINDINGS v2 §0.1: the bosonic upper-bound stack is also outside the strict H1-H6 envelope because it is bosonic/infinite-dimensional and asymptotic, so H4 finite-cutoff and H5 composable-security coverage are not present either. This blurs the strict-vs-relaxed boundary in the section presented as a citation table.
issues.suggestion: Change the `T1` scope cell to something like `point-to-point bosonic/asymptotic theorem; also relaxes H4/H5/H6`, or remove it from the main-question answer table if the goal is to preserve the strict H1-H6 boundary cleanly.

round_recommendation: Remove the reintroduced γ-attribution claim, fix all upgrade-path wording to the `C1 ∧ C2 ∧ C3` invariant, and correct the lower-bound/scope statements in §§5-7 and §10 before re-reviewing this snapshot.
